summary: Defines an XML Signature transform called XPath Filter 2.0. XML Signature lets part of an XML document be signed, and the original XPath transform can be hard to implement efficiently. This offers another way to pick the subset of a document to sign. It is informational.

eli5.summary: You want to sign only part of a long letter. The old way of marking those parts was slow and clumsy. This is a smoother way to point at exactly the parts you want signed.

questions: how to sign part of an xml document
